subject: general
question: The Shailendra kings who had close contacts with the Indian rulers were followers of which of the following religions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Shailendra kings were followers of **Buddhism**.
 
• The Shailendra dynasty had close contacts with Indian rulers, particularly with the rulers of the Pala dynasty, who were also patrons of Buddhism.
 
• The Shailendra dynasty is known for its significant contribution to Buddhist arc
